notes: Giveaway phase 1 extended with a third task: leaving a review on Trustpilot. Unlike Telegram/YouTube (checked automatically), there's no public API to confirm a Trustpilot review is real, so the user pastes a link to their review as proof instead - it lands in Giveaway > Claims marked 'needs manual check' rather than 'verified', so the admin can go look at the actual review before rewarding it. New Trustpilot section on Giveaway > Settings (enable toggle + review page URL).
